CustomField.description: True when the caller that created/updated this Account (VendorPortalController.upsertSupplier, SubSupplierController.inviteSubSupplier) already persisted a deliberately-curated Compliance_Assessment__c checklist — e.g. after Procurement removed suggested documents on the P1 preview, or a sub-supplier's copied subset of the parent's requirements. When true, ScopeCalloutQueueable (fired from AccountTriggerHandler.afterInsert/afterUpdate) skips re-deriving and upserting a fresh full checklist from /scope, so it doesn't silently resurrect removed documents or duplicate the curated set. Risk tier/score/domains are still computed and written either way. Set in the SAME insert/update DML that creates the record, since AccountTriggerHandler reads it synchronously during that DML — setting it afterward is too late.
CustomField.label: Checklist Seeded By Caller
